dominant_critical_path.A1: exposed buffered ext4/page-cache storage service plus the remaining dependency/host gap; scheduler wake/run latency is not material
dominant_critical_path.S0: exposed buffered ext4/page-cache storage service; scheduler wake/run latency is not material
dominant_critical_path.basis: non-additive Perfetto service unions, CUPTI useful/idle intervals, scheduler thread-state attribution, and decode-relevant perf samples

A1.materiality_rule: inference-main runnable delay >=5% of window, or a role with >=10 samples has p95 >=2 ms; concurrent worker runnable sums are not treated as wall time

S0.materiality_rule: inference-main runnable delay >=5% of window, or a role with >=10 samples has p95 >=2 ms; concurrent worker runnable sums are not treated as wall time

selection.reason: run the bounded affinity comparator only when traced runnable delay is material

capacity_curve.stop_reason: 32 GiB produced no physical-read/reuse capacity curve and regressed decode; 64 GiB was therefore not tested

exit.issue44_handoff: retain fit-in-RAM vs K3 out-of-core distinction and run native io_uring E2E comparison on the next capable discrete-CUDA host

host_read_ahead_control_64_gib.reason: the single bounded S0 screen exceeded 12x the normal whole-run elapsed time without completing, so it was not promoted to S1/A1

result.decision: reject read_ahead_kb=0 after the single authorized short screen; do not promote to S1/A1
result.termination: owned service stopped after bounded screen established a decisive initialization/decode regression

candidate_ctest.disposition: rejected candidate was not hardened after failing the E2E selection gate; all experimental runtime code was removed
